`enum GlStateKey`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.render.state` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlStateKey.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/render/state/GlStateKey.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The kinds of OpenGL state that the journal records, in the order in which it restores them.

## Learn more

- [The state journal](/build/embedding-in-a-host/#the-state-journal)
